name: C2b1a2a1b (F6379)
description: C2b1a2a1b (F6379) is a terminal subclade of C2b1a2a within the broader C2b1a2 (M48) Mongolic branch. Defined by the F6379 marker, this lineage represents a fine-scale Iron Age differentiation of the non-Star-Cluster Mongolic C2b diversity on the Mongolian Plateau. Its carriers today are found at low frequencies among Mongolian and Inner Mongolian populations.
interestingFact: F6379 is one of many 'shadow lineages' on the Mongolian Plateau — branches that were demographically outcompeted by the explosive expansion of the Star Cluster during the Mongol Empire, surviving today only as rare but distinct patrilineal markers of Mongolia's pre-imperial genetic diversity.
references: Balaresque et al. (2015) — Y-chromosome descent clusters and male differential reproductive success. European Journal of Human Genetics 23, 1357–1362.
